messages:
maya (prod PM): quick sync: Atlas asked for a pin + shadowing while they finish regression. need TTL, canary, and customer wording. short answers pls.

selene (research): smokebench highlights:
aurora-lite (rtx-a6000): p95=160ms (seq512), q4_0 -> p95=140ms with ~0.6% summarization drop.
pegasus-embed (t4): avg embed=12ms, cosine=0.89.

aj (eng): constraints: soft pin up to 90d without infra work. >90d -> routing flag + capacity commit. canary tooling ready for staged ramps.

nora (support): Atlas wants no silent cut and ability to shadow traffic. they asked for 6 months.

samir (sde): proposal:
- default soft pin: 90 days
- console opt-in extension: +30 days (SLA checkbox)
- hard pin >=180 days only with reserved capacity contract
- canary: 1% -> 5% over 48h -> 25% over 72h; abort triggers: error-rate >0.5%, p95 >2x baseline, eval drop >1% abs, cost delta >15% at 25% (early warn at 8% at 5%)

maya (prod PM): draft customer language: "Soft pin (90d): we route to your selected variant; in emergencies we may reroute but will notify and provide remediation. Extensions available via Console. Hard pins need contract."

ops-bot: canary template: https://internal.redwood/ops/canary-template

nora (support): will add fields to pin request form: requested TTL, shadowing opt-in, reason. will prepare support playbook and TTL reminders.

selene (research): add long-tail 5% probe to smokebench mandatory.

aj (eng): :white_check_mark:
samir (sde): :white_check_mark: creating INF-1321 to add eval hooks and cost checks
nora (support): :white_check_mark:
maya (prod PM): thanks — i'll publish TTL + canary requirements to catalog docs after tickets land.
